description: Create (upsert) a custom field value for an entity. The table stores values in typed columns - prefer setting the one that matches the field definition's field_type: value_text (text/select; a select value must be one of the field's options), value_number (number), value_date (date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD), value_boolean (boolean). Alternatively pass a single `value` string and the server will dispatch it to the right column based on field_type. Writes upsert on (entity_id, field_definition_id) so replaying a batch is idempotent. Requires custom_fields:write scope.

field_definition_id.description: Custom field definition ID - resolve via list_custom_field_definitions (required)

value.description: Legacy single-value shim - server dispatches to the correct typed column based on the field definition's field_type. Ignored if any value_* typed column is set.

value_date.description: Date value, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (use for field_type=date)

value_text.description: Text value (use for field_type=text or select)

name: create_custom_field_value
title: Create custom field value
